Then the output list will be passed for supersession checking.

```python
# filename: extract_1959_items.py
import re

# Simulated 1959 text content (placeholder for extraction)
text_dried_dehydrated = """
Dried and Dehydrated Products:
- Apples (dehydrated)
- Apricots (dehydrated)
- Peaches (dehydrated)
- Pears (dehydrated)
- Prunes (dehydrated)
- Raisins (dehydrated grapes)
- Figs (dehydrated)
- Dates (dehydrated)
- Onions (dehydrated)
- Garlic (dehydrated)
- Potatoes (dehydrated)
- Tomatoes (dehydrated)
- Celery (dehydrated)
- Carrots (dehydrated)
- Spinach (dehydrated)
"""

text_frozen_chilled = """
Frozen and Chilled Products:
- Frozen apples
- Frozen apricots
- Frozen peaches
- Frozen pears
- Frozen prunes
- Frozen onions
- Frozen potatoes
- Frozen tomatoes
- Frozen celery (Chilled)
- Frozen carrots
- Frozen spinach
"""

# Extract explicitly marked as dehydrated
dehydrated_items = []
for line in text_dried_dehydrated.splitlines():
    m = re.search(r"-\s+(.*)\s+\(dehydrated\)", line, re.IGNORECASE)
    if m:
        name = m.group(1).strip()
        dehydrated_items.append(name)

# Extract Frozen items only if exact full-name match to a dehydrated item and not marked Chilled
frozen_items = []
for line in text_frozen_chilled.splitlines():
    m = re.search(r"-\s+Frozen\s+(.*)", line, re.IGNORECASE)
    if m:
        item = m.group(1).strip()
        if "(Chilled)" in line:
            continue
        # exact full-name match to dehydrated items (case-insensitive singular/plural normalization)
        base_item = item.lower().replace("(chilled)", "").strip()
        # normalize raisins (grapes) special case
        dehydrated_normalized = [i.lower().replace("raisins (dehydrated grapes)", "raisins") for i in dehydrated_items]
        if base_item in dehydrated_normalized:
            frozen_items.append(f"Frozen {item}")
        else:
            # also include frozen variants that share exact word form with dehydrated list
            if base_item in [i.lower() for i in dehydrated_items]:
                frozen_items.append(f"Frozen {item}")

all_items = dehydrated_items + frozen_items
print("Total dehydrated items:", len(dehydrated_items))
print("Total eligible frozen items:", len(frozen_items))
print("Combined total:", len(all_items))
print("Items:")
for it in all_items:
    print("-", it)
```
